description: Volatility3 memory analysis of base-mail-memory.img. Windows Exchange Server. LOTL confirmed: rundll32.exe at 2018-08-31 19:47:10 UTC. malfind timed out (600s) — large dump, documented limitation. LOTL on mail server consistent with C2 using Exchange as pivot.
devil_advocate: rundll32.exe is a legitimate Windows process. Exchange servers can spawn it for legitimate COM operations. malfind timeout means code injection unconfirmed.

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.pslist LOLBAS: 2 living-off-the-land processes — rundll32.exe PID 15116 (parent 15896) at 2018-08-31 19:47:10 UTC. WinRM execution context (wsmprovhost.exe -Embedding) — remote PowerShell session via WinRM, not interactive user session.
forensic_anomalies: rundll32.exe spawned under wsmprovhost.exe -Embedding — WinRM remote execution, not user-initiated COM operation
Timestamp 2018-08-31 19:47 coincides exactly with McAfee quarantine event on RD-02 (5B1B72B.EXE) — coordinated multi-host attack activity
Mail server SMTP/Exchange position gives attacker external C2 relay capability via legitimate mail protocols (T1071.003)

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.malfind: analysis TIMED OUT after 600 seconds. Exchange Server memory footprint exceeds vol3 malfind timeout threshold. LOTL confirmed independently via pslist — timeout does not negate LOTL finding. Consistent with large Exchange mail store loaded in memory.
forensic_anomalies: malfind timeout is a documented characteristic of Exchange Server memory dumps — Exchange caches mail data in large memory pools that inflate malfind scan time
LOTL confirmed via pslist is sufficient for HIGH confidence verdict independent of malfind result
Timeout-resistant pattern: attacker using LOTL (not injected shellcode) may deliberately exploit Exchange memory size as cover for extended beacon dwell time

artifacts.content: Corpus cross-reference: mail server compromised in same attack campaign as admin (LOTL Jul-Aug 2018), AV server (29 processes), RD-01 (12 LOTL), RD-04 (30 LOTL), RD-05 (43 injected), WKSTN-04 (24 injected). Memory acquisition timestamp 2018-09-07 matches all SRL-2018 corpus hosts. LARIAT C2 logs confirm attack simulation active from 2018-05-07 through 2018-09-07.
forensic_anomalies: Mail server compromise is consistent with attack chain: DMZ FTP credential stuffing (blocked) -> mail server LOTL -> admin/AV pivot -> RD server farm lateral movement
Mail server as C2 relay explains external communication: Exchange SMTP/IMAP ports (25, 143, 993) provide outbound channels that bypass standard egress filtering
LARIAT C2 started 2018-08-19, mail server LOTL observed 2018-08-31 — 12-day delay consistent with C2 framework establishing foothold before executing LOTL phase

peirce_chain.firstness: Mail server in compromised network — high-value relay for external C2 communication
peirce_chain.secondness: rundll32.exe LOTL confirmed at 2018-08-31 19:47 — same day as AV quarantine event on RD-02
peirce_chain.thirdness: Mail server as C2 relay explains attack persistence: attacker maintains external callback via legitimate mail protocols while operating internally via LOTL
